messages:
marco_sales: Quick thread for Clinicare POC. They want a redacted SOC2 summary, ISO scope, and a signed pen-test attestation that explicitly mentions EU data residency and the POC timeline. Also asking for a network sketch for a 10-day private UAT. Need evidence by 2025-04-10. Can SE + Compliance confirm what we can send and the pricing delta?

anya_se: @viv_compliance @julia_legal for visibility. Networking options for the UAT: 1) temporary mTLS VPN (fast), 2) VPC peering with strict ACLs (longer), or 3) static egress IPs via SSH bastion (quickest). SAML not required for initial tests; ephemeral creds OK.

viv_compliance: We can provide: redacted SOC2 Type II exec summary, ISO27001 scope, and a pen-test attestation letter (high-level only). We will not share raw pen-test reports or raw audit logs without an NDA and legal review. Redaction rules: remove customer PII, internal IPs, raw exploit PoCs, employee IDs. Public CVE IDs can be included.

client_kevin: Procurement: "Please include the legal signatory on the attestation, whether CVE IDs will be listed, and a line-item price for EU node + one-time setup. Also confirm transfer method (SFTP vs presigned S3)."

billing_bot: Pricing snippet: EU temporary UAT node (10 days, pro-rated) = $1,900 one-time. mTLS VPN setup = $1,200 one-time. Static egress IPs (2 IPs) = $450 one-time. Presigned S3 transfer prep/packaging = $150 one-time. Dedicated log retention (30d) add-on = $300/month (pro-rated).

julia_legal: Signatory: Julia Park, General Counsel. I can sign the attestation within 48 hours after the final draft is approved. If Clinicare requests the full pen-test report that requires an NDA and ~7 business days for legal/security review.

anya_se: For UAT creds we'll issue ephemeral accounts with read-only API keys that auto-expire after 14 days. Snippet for devs:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer CLINICARE_UAT_KEY" https://eu.api.redwood.inference/v1/health
```
Keys are rotated after the UAT window.

viv_compliance: Evidence pack checklist:
- Redacted SOC2 Type II executive summary + control mapping (no customer identifiers)
- ISO27001 scope PDF
- Pen-test attestation letter (signed, high-level findings, public CVEs allowed)
- Staging network diagram (UAT only)
- Evidence-handling attestation template for Clinicare to sign before transfer
If Clinicare insists on the full report, send NDA template and expect longer lead time.

client_kevin: They prefer presigned S3 (7-day expiry). Procurement also asked that the pen-test attestation name Clinicare as the requesting party and list public CVE IDs if available.

julia_legal: We'll address the attestation to Clinicare and include public CVE IDs where possible. Final wording to be confirmed; I will sign after approval.

marco_sales: Action items (recap):
1) @viv_compliance draft redacted pack + pen-test attestation by 2025-04-04.
2) @billing_bot prepare formal amendment with the line items and send to Clinicare by EOD.
3) @anya_se prepare presigned S3 workflow (7d expiry) and ephemeral key issuance plan.
4) Julia to sign final attestation within 48h of draft approval.

client_kevin: One more procurement Q: will the attestation include a short statement about evidence deletion policy on our side after a successful handoff? They want assurance.

viv_compliance: Yes — we'll include a one-paragraph evidence handling statement confirming Redwood will remove any temporary evidence copies from staging storage 7 days after transfer completion unless otherwise agreed in writing. That will be part of the attestation.

anya_se: Potential blocker: if Clinicare asks for raw logs or internal vulnerability PoCs we must pause and route through NDA/legal review. Flagging now.

marco_sales: Great, thanks all. I'll summarize in an email to Clinicare and attach the amendment once billing posts it. :thumbsup:
